question: Is there one document, anywhere, that a script can read, stating how many PM SHRI schools were sanctioned, to which states, and how much money was released?
refusal: This file publishes whether a document answered, its shape, and how many times a named pattern appeared in it. It publishes no school count, no funding figure and no claim about the scheme.
note: The citation harvest found three pieces on this scheme against five hundred and seven on the SC/ST Act. That gap is not an artefact of the collector: the scheme has no encyclopaedia article, the ministry's page for it is a JavaScript shell, the portal renders its counts in the browser, and Parliament's question API answers 404. Everything reachable so far has been reachable and empty, which is why every target here names the figure it is after.

findings.what: PIB — a release under the PressReleasePage path
findings.settles: Whether a release carries its own body text under this path, so official claims can be quoted with a date and an id

findings.what: PIB — the same release under the PressReleseDetail path
findings.settles: Whether the two PIB paths differ in what they carry, which decides which one a connector should read

findings.what: PIB — releases filtered to the Ministry of Education
findings.settles: Whether the release id is honoured — two different ids must return two different bodies, or the archive cannot be walked

findings.what: PM SHRI portal — a statistics call
findings.settles: Whether the portal's browser-side counts can be read by a script, which would make them the primary figure

findings.what: PM SHRI portal — a state-wise call
findings.settles: Whether the portal serves the state-wise distribution, which is where the whole dispute lives

findings.what: PM SHRI portal — the shell itself, read again for a data island
findings.settles: Whether the shell embeds its counts in the page as JSON, which some government SPAs do

findings.what: Lok Sabha questions — the search the site's own page calls
findings.settles: Whether the question archive answers a script under any path, which would put dated state-wise figures within reach

findings.what: Lok Sabha questions — the human-readable archive
findings.settles: Whether the archive pages at all, which decides whether it can be walked or only opened

findings.what: Ministry of Education — the annual report listing
findings.settles: Whether the ministry publishes a report carrying the scheme's own numbers, as a document rather than an application

findings.what: Ministry of Education — the schemes listing
findings.settles: Whether the ministry lists the scheme with figures beside it

findings.what: The Hindu — site search for the scheme
findings.settles: Whether a newsroom archive can be searched by a script, which is the only route to coverage older than a feed

findings.what: Google News RSS — a keyword search over the news archive
findings.settles: Whether press coverage of the scheme can be searched rather than waited for, which decides whether this page can be built at all

findings.what: Google News RSS — the same search for the Act
findings.settles: Whether the same route would deepen the Act's register too, which is currently one item per sweep from five feeds

findings.what: Bing News RSS — the same question put to a second index
findings.settles: Whether a second index answers, so the register does not depend on one company's endpoint
